narrative.overview:
The site is a spectrometer reading of a hydrogen career. Hydrogen identifies itself by its emission lines, so every paper, chapter, thesis and tool is a crisp vertical line on a dark plate, placed by year and coloured by the research series it belongs to. The plate is the timeline and the navigation at once; everything else (legend, stepper, readout, lists) is the instrument built around it.

Two materials alternate. Dark sections sit on a deep blue ground with a darker plate strip, carrying near-white text and a single signal-yellow action colour. Reading sections switch to a neutral, slightly cool paper with deep blue ink. Hand-lettered display type gives the voice a personal, drawn quality against measured, ruled structure: tick-scale rules frame every list, mono readouts carry every number, and the line style of a mark tells a work's stage. Lines are flat and crisp, with no glow and no gradients.

Density is moderate and editorial. Lists are ruled rows with generous vertical padding, never cards. Motion is limited to lines igniting in chronological order on load, a slit cursor that slides to the selected line, and small press feedback on actions; reduced motion shows the plate static.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed spectral plate with a quarter-ticked year ruler as the signature structure
Deep blue ground and plate, neutral paper for reading, one signal-yellow action colour
Five Balmer series colours, each with a plate colour and a paper-safe ink
Handwritten display (Playpen Sans), plain sans body (Funnel Sans), mono only for measurements
Stage encoded by line style: solid, dashed, dotted
Ruled lists under a tick-scale top rule; no cards for list content

rules.name: The No Pastel Blue Rule
rules.body: The blues are deep (ground, plate, ink). No periwinkle, light blue, cyan or violet anywhere, in text, accents or series colours. Secondary text is neutral grey, not tinted blue.

rules.name: The Line-Owns-Its-Colour Rule
rules.body: Series colours appear only to identify a series (emission lines, symbols, stage marks, series names, legend keys, filter chips). They are never decoration, section fills or button colours.

rules.name: The Paper-Ink Rule
rules.body: On paper, series text and marks always use the -ink variant; the bright plate colour is reserved for dark grounds and the plate strips.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Measured Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono appears only on a number, identifier or physical quantity (nm, year, DOI, TRL, count). Never on prose, labels or headings.

rules.name: The Facts-in-Sans Rule
rules.body: Paper titles, venues and authors are set in Funnel Sans; the hand face never sets a bibliographic fact.

rules.name: The Readout Order Rule
rules.body: A work reads title, then venue (and authors), then a meta row of series, year and stage. Nothing sits above the title: no kicker, eyebrow or category label.

rules.name: The Ticked List Rule
rules.body: Every list of works, series, records or projects starts under a tick-scale top rule: a 1.5px baseline with major ticks every 80px and minor ticks every 16px, drawn in the list's current colour.

rules.name: The Keys-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Offset shadows belong to actions and nothing else. Plates, strips, cards, lists and the header stay flat.

rules.name: The Stage-By-Line Rule
rules.body: Stage is shown by line style everywhere: solid for published, dashed for under review, dotted for in preparation. The same code applies to plate lines, mini plates and the stage mark before a status label.

dos: **Do** place every work on the plate as an emission line at its year, coloured by series and styled by stage.
**Do** frame every list with the tick-scale top rule and separate rows with 1px rules.
**Do** use Signal Yellow with Signal Ink for the primary action, the current-page underline and focus on dark ground.
**Do** use the -ink series colours for any series text or mark on paper.
**Do** set wavelengths, years, DOIs and identifiers in Martian Mono and nothing else in it.
**Do** keep lines flat and crisp; show selection by widening a line, not by glowing it.
**Do** honour reduced motion: no ignition animation and no smooth scroll.
donts: **Don't** use light or periwinkle blue, purple or violet, or pool cyan anywhere in the palette.
**Don't** put a kicker, eyebrow or category label above a title; the readout order is title, venue, meta.
**Don't** add glow, gradients or blur to emission lines or plates.
**Don't** use series colours as decoration, section fills or button colours.
**Don't** turn list items into cards; the citation card is the only card.
**Don't** use offset shadows on anything that is not an action.
**Don't** show results, figures or data for works under review; topic and status only.
